annotations.text:
Direction B built as the final, in the professional palette now live in the app:

• Rail #16202e (navy-slate) · accent #1f5b9e (marine blue)
• Alerts: #b3261e critical · #96610a warning · #0e7a55 positive
• Quiet states carry no chroma — color is an alert channel
• Type unchanged: Barlow / Barlow Condensed / IBM Plex Mono

The unchosen explorations (A, C, D) live on the Explorations page, kept in their original teal for comparison.

What the research says, and which direction carries it:

• Wise Systems — live map as the workspace, color-coded routes, drag re-sequencing → A
• Turvo — exceptions fast to resolve; issue + impact + recommended action in one view → B (chosen); screens follow the shipment lifecycle → C
• Samsara — left rail, map-first, collapsible panels → A and D
• Dashboard practice — chroma only for alerts, dense rows, one prioritized action feed → applied to all four
